title: Remote holder
summary: A pocket or cradle that holds a remote control, free-standing or mounted.

questions.label: Remote width
questions.why: Sets the pocket width. Measure across the widest point.

questions.label: Remote thickness
questions.why: Sets the pocket depth front to back.

questions.label: Remote length
questions.why: Decides how much of the remote the pocket covers and how tall the holder is.

questions.label: Corner radius of the remote
questions.why: A pocket with sharper corners than the remote leaves gaps; rounder corners bind.

questions.label: How it goes in
questions.why: Decides where the opening and the entry chamfer go.

questions.label: Mounting
questions.why: Free-standing needs a stable base; a wall mount needs a flat back or screw access.

load.note: Remote weight plus a hand pulling it out.

material.why: Indoor, low load, stiff and easy to print.
material.consider: PETG if it lives near a window or a heater.

checks.name: Pocket clearance
checks.why: The remote slides in and out without rattling.

checks.name: Finger access
checks.why: A finger can reach the remote to pull it out.

checks.name: Retention coupon
checks.why: A thin ring or slice of the pocket printed first to check the fit.

checks.name: Mounting interface
checks.why: The base is stable or the wall fixing has a flat face and tool access.
